# PhotoSwipe 5.4.4

These files are unmodified copies of the official npm package `photoswipe@5.4.4`, downloaded from jsDelivr on 2026-11-06:

- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/photoswipe@5.4.4/dist/photoswipe.css`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/photoswipe@5.4.4/dist/photoswipe.esm.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/photoswipe@5.4.4/dist/photoswipe-lightbox.esm.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/photoswipe@5.4.4/LICENSE`

Project page: `https://photoswipe.com/`; source repository: `https://github.com/dimsemenov/PhotoSwipe`.

The two ESM files contain no relative imports; the CSS contains no `url()` references or `@import` rules. All three can be served from this directory.

`LICENSE` is the MIT license shipped with PhotoSwipe. The site-level partial `layouts/_partials/article/components/photoswipe.html` loads these files through Hugo's `relURL` so GitHub Pages project subpaths resolve correctly.
